npcs.name: Farmer Chuckie
npcs.role: Owner of Chuckie's Cheese, Lariat's big dairy and cheese company (CHZ on the exchange). Cheerful, folksy, and missing five very important cows.

npcs.name: Opal Haskins
npcs.role: Runs the Lariat Mercantile: groceries, hardware, rope, hats, and every bit of news in the county.

npcs.name: Dale Pruett
npcs.role: Sells tractors on the Red Dirt Tractor & Implement lot. Talks horsepower like other men talk weather.

npcs.name: Lorna Calloway
npcs.role: Runs Lone Star Feed & Seed, and in the afternoons sits at the Land Office as the county's land agent.

npcs.name: Wes Tolliver
npcs.role: Runs Hoof & Horn Livestock Supply and the Saturday sale barn. Can guess a steer's weight to the pound.

npcs.name: Lupe Garza
npcs.role: Owner and cook of the Mesquite Diner. Chicken-fried steak, pecan pie, and the coffee that runs Lariat.

npcs.name: Wade Tillman
npcs.role: Dairy hand at Chuckie's Cheese: milking, feeding, mucking out. Talks to the cows nicer than to people.

npcs.name: Rosa Delgado
npcs.role: Head cheesemaker at Chuckie's Cheese. The finest cheddar in the state, and she'll tell you so.

npcs.name: Earl Hollister
npcs.role: Cotton farmer on the Hollister place north of town. Fourth generation; first to say it might not need a fifth.

npcs.name: Bessie Mae
npcs.role: A lead cow of Chuckie's Cheese. A Southern belle with expensive tastes in pie.

npcs.name: Dr. Clementine
npcs.role: A lead cow of Chuckie's Cheese. Holds strong views on philosophy, grass and the nature of the fence.

npcs.name: Duchess
npcs.role: A lead cow of Chuckie's Cheese. Convinced the cheese plant is a conspiracy. Partly right.

npcs.name: Patsy
npcs.role: A lead cow of Chuckie's Cheese. A country singer. Not a good one. A loud one.

npcs.name: Little Daisy
npcs.role: The youngest lead cow of Chuckie's Cheese. Wants an adventure. Is having one.

npcs.name: Hollis Marsh
npcs.role: Manager and loan officer of the Lariat State Bank, est. 1911. Lends to farmers, ranchers and anyone with shares worth the paper, and knows which is which.

npcs.name: Dottie Cain
npcs.role: Teller at the Lariat State Bank. Counts the cotton money twice, knows every farmer's deposit by the dirt on the envelope, and hums hymns at the window.

npcs.name: Clint Brazos
npcs.role: Guard at the Lariat State Bank, and a deputy in a past life. Has stood by that door for fifty-one years without a robbery, and takes it personally.
